messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Dedicated capacity update: were launching H100-80GB and A100-80GB pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 next week. Reservations open now in the Console. Quick bullet TL;DR below, full details in the doc link at the bottom.

Maya: Timeline: 
- Reservations open: today 11:00 PT (console + API)
- Soft launch / canary: 2025-11-03 02:00 PT (early-access orgs only)
- GA: 2025-11-05 08:00 PT (general Dedicated availability)

Maya: Regions & zones: us-west-2 (a, b) and eu-west-1 (a, c) initially. We'll add additional AZs after the first week based on utilization.

Maya: GPU SKUs: h100-80gb-std, a100-80gb-std. We support mixed-pool reservations (H100 + A100) and soft-burst behavior. Minimum reservation: 4 GPUs. Initial capacity is limited — reservations are allocated by commit date and expected start.

Maya: Pricing & quotas: pricing is live in the Console under Dedicated -> Reservations. Expect ~20% premium on H100 vs our current A10X baseline for on-reserve pricing. Quota updates will be automatic for existing Dedicated customers but can be raised on request.

Maya: Behavior notes:
- Automatic fallback enabled: if requested pool is exhausted, routing policy can fallback to compatible pool (e.g., a100-80 -> a100-40) if you allow it.
- Eviction policy: low-priority/best-effort workloads may be preempted during peak until committed capacity comes online.

Maya: Migration & ops: pin workloads during migration window if you need deterministic placement. We're shipping a migration playbook and a one-click reservation migration tool in Console.

Maya: Example CLI to create a reservation:
```
rwctl reservations create --region us-west-2 --pool h100-80gb-std --count 4 --commit 12m
```

Priya: Thanks Maya — will update docs, pricing page, and the Dedicated product page. Can you paste the exact per-hour examples so I can include them in the PR? @Maya

Maya: SKUs & sample math: h100-80gb-std, a100-80gb-std. Example: 4x h100-80 (reserved 12 months) ~ $X/hour per GPU (see Console pricing tab for org-specific rates). I'll DM you the concrete numbers for the PR.

Sam: SRE note: we'll enable placement policies that can evict best-effort workloads during peak. Running capacity & failover tests Thu 03:00 UTC — if your team needs to be on-call for the tests, please sign up in the calendar invite I'll post.

Jorge: Sales note — do not promise immediate availability to customers yet. Initial allocation is prioritized for committed reserved contracts. @sales-team: if you have queued contracts that require H100, DM me the contract IDs and I'll coordinate priority assignment.

CapacityBot: [automated] Reservations API schema updated: /v1/dedicated/reservations now returns new pool types (h100-80gb-std, a100-80gb-std). See API changelog.

Priya: Can we get target SLOs for latency on larger context workloads? H100 expected to reduce p95 for 32k+ context.

Maya: Initial SLO guidance: aim for 99.9% availability for reserved capacity; we'll publish machine-level p50/p95 numbers in the telemetry dashboard after 72 hours of GA traffic. Early numbers from canary show ~18-25% p95 improvement for long-context generative tasks on H100.

Ellie: Legal note — certain regulated customers will need updated DPA language for H100 usage in eu-west-1. I'll circulate a short addendum; please flag any customers who might need this.

Sam: We'll post the loadtest results and a list of known issues in #eng-sre after the run. If any teams want to join the test queue, reply here.

Maya: Action items:
- Sales: don't promise immediate GA capacity, coordinate with Jorge.
- Product/docs: Priya to update pricing + reservation UX copy.
- SRE/Infra: Sam to run tests and publish playbook + migration steps.
- Legal: Ellie to share DPA addendum if needed.

Maya: TL;DR: Reservations open now in Console, limited initial capacity, H100/A100 pools live in us-west-2 & eu-west-1, contact ops for early access. Full rollout doc: https://internal.redwood/dedicated/h100-a100-rollout 

Maya: Ping me or DM if you need early-access toggles or want to be on the test run. :rocket:
